HEYMIX LIFE Single Monitor Arm, Ergonomic Monitor Stand VESA Mount

Mounting TypeTabletop Mount
Movement TypeRotate, Swivel, Tilt, Articulating
BrandHEYMIX LIFE
MaterialAlloy Steel

  • 【Compatibility】: Supports screens from 13" to 32" weighing 2kg to 9kg. Mounting patterns are VESA 75x75mm or 100x100mm.
